Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) old wooden table
(B) wooden old table

The correct order is: Material (wooden) -> Age (old) -> Noun (table). So, the correct sentence is (B) wooden old table.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) beautiful small Italian restaurant
(B) Italian beautiful small restaurant

The correct order is: Opinion (beautiful) -> Size (small) -> Origin (Italian) -> Noun (restaurant). So, the correct sentence is (A) beautiful small Italian restaurant.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) large electronic blue television
(B) blue electronic large television

The correct order is: Size (large) -> Material (electronic) -> Color (blue) -> Noun (television). So, the correct sentence is (A) large electronic blue television.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) old exercise bike
(B) exercise old bike

The correct order is: Purpose (exercise) -> Age (old) -> Noun (bike). So, the correct sentence is (A) old exercise bike.
